mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and overcast at Badger Prairie County Park. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will reach an overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the engineering department has provided its latest reports to the city council, and residents should prepare for the fall leaf collection season starting October 5, which requires loose leaves to be placed behind the curb.

There is plenty to do today including yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, we have trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus and the popular Verona Fall Fest this Thursday.
In a report from September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a facility remodel, so we look forward to their return soon.
